Cell type specific signatures

```{r}
library(ArchR)
addArchRGenome("hg38")

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyr)
library(stringi)
library(patchwork)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(writexl)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggdendro)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(GOSemSim)
library(enrichplot)
library(dplyr)

colour <- c(Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff","Neuronal IPC" = "#40a1ff", 'Radial glia'="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0")
```


# 1. Forebrain vs Hindbrain
```{r}
# add forebrain and hindbrain
ArchR_EHB$Region_FvH <- ArchR_EHB$Region
ArchR_EHB$Region_FvH[ArchR_EHB$Region_FvH!="Forebrain"] <- "Hindbrain"

# exluding erythrocytes and fibroblasts, 71250 cells remaining
ArchR_EHB_5ct <- ArchR_EHB[!ArchR_EHB$ctAnnot_2.0 %in% c("Fibroblast","Erythrocyte")]
table(ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0)
```

## (1) bulk DA
```{r}
table(ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region_FvH)

# down-sample to match the statistical power for comparing by age! (3000)
# differential analysis ~ 1 min
FBvHB_bulk <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchR_EHB_5ct, useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", groupBy = "Region_FvH",
                                useGroups = "Forebrain", bgdGroups = "Hindbrain", 
                                bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), testMethod = "wilcoxon", 
                                k = 100, maxCells = 3000)
```

```{r}
# summary
FBvHB_bulk_up <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(FBvHB_bulk, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6"))
FBvHB_bulk_down <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(FBvHB_bulk, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC <= -0.6"))

# prepare plot
allpeaks <- getMarkers(FBvHB_bulk, cutOff = "FDR <= 10 & Log2FC > -10000")
allpeaks <- as.data.frame(allpeaks@listData[[1]])
allpeaks$DAR <- "non-DAR"
allpeaks$DAR[allpeaks$FDR <= 0.01 & allpeaks$Log2FC >= 0.6] <- "hyper-accessible"
allpeaks$DAR[allpeaks$FDR <= 0.01 & allpeaks$Log2FC <= -0.6] <- "hypo-accessible"
allpeaks$DAR <- factor(allpeaks$DAR, levels = c("hypo-accessible", "non-DAR","hyper-accessible"))
top <- rbind(FBvHB_bulk_up[1:10,], FBvHB_bulk_down[1:8,])
colnames(top) <- sub(".*\\.", "", colnames(top))

# volcano plot
p1 <- ggplot(allpeaks, aes(x=Log2FC, y=-log10(FDR))) + 
  geom_point(aes(color=DAR, size=FDR), alpha = 0.7, shape=19) + 
  xlab("log2(fold change)") + ylab("-log10(FDR)") + 
  ggtitle("Forebrain vs Hindbrain, all ages") + theme_minimal() + 
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title="Direction", override.aes = list(shape=19, size=2)), size = guide_legend(title="FDR")) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#53CC67", "grey","#FDE333")) +
  scale_size_continuous(trans = "reverse",breaks = c(1,0.05, 0.01), limits = c(1,0),range = c(1,2), name = "FDR") + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 13), plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face="bold", vjust = 2.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) + 
  geom_label_repel(size = 3, data = top, min.segment.length = unit(0, 'lines'), 
                   aes(x = Log2FC, y = -log10(FDR), label=name, size=0.1),
                   show.legend=FALSE, max.overlaps = 10, force = 150)

rm(allpeaks, top, FBvHB_bulk_down, FBvHB_bulk_up)
```


## (2) split age DA
```{r}
# down-sample: lowest = 2076, downsample to 3000
for (x in unique(ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region_FvH)){
  print(x)
  print(table(ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region_FvH==x]$Age))
}

# differential analysis (geneScore) ~ 2 min
FBvHB_splitAge <- list()
for (x in unique(ArchR_EHB_5ct$Age)){
  FBvHB_splitAge[[x]] <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$Age==x], useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", 
                            groupBy = "Region_FvH", useGroups = "Forebrain", bgdGroups = "Hindbrain", 
                            bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), testMethod = "wilcoxon", 
                            k = 100, maxCells = 3000)
  rm(x)
}
```

### supp fig - volcano grid
```{r}
# summary
FBvHB_splitAge_up <- list()
FBvHB_splitAge_down <- list()
for (x in names(FBvHB_splitAge)){
  FBvHB_splitAge_up[[x]] <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(FBvHB_splitAge[[x]], cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6"))
  FBvHB_splitAge_down[[x]] <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(FBvHB_splitAge[[x]], cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC <= -0.6"))
  rm(x)
  
}

# prepare plot
allpeaks <- FBvHB_splitAge[[5]]
allpeaks@colData@nrows <- length(FBvHB_splitAge)
allpeaks@colData@rownames <- names(FBvHB_splitAge)[c(5,1:4)]
for (x in 1:4){
  for (y in 1:7){
    allpeaks@assays@data[[y]] <- cbind(allpeaks@assays@data[[y]], FBvHB_splitAge[[x]]@assays@data[[y]])
  }
  rm(x,y)
}
allpeaks <- getMarkers(allpeaks, cutOff = "FDR <= 10 & Log2FC > -10000")  # the total number of peaks might differ among cell types, because peaks with FDR=NA have been removed

# volcano plot
p2 <- list()
for (x in c("CS14","CS16","CS17","CS20","CS21")){
  all <- as.data.frame(allpeaks@listData[[x]])
  all$DAR <- "non-DAR"
  all$DAR[all$FDR <= 0.05 & all$Log2FC >= 0.6] <- "hyper-accessible"
  all$DAR[all$FDR <= 0.05 & all$Log2FC <= -0.6] <- "hypo-accessible"
  all$DAR <- factor(all$DAR, levels = c("hypo-accessible", "non-DAR","hyper-accessible"))
  top <- rbind(FBvHB_splitAge_up[[x]][1:8,], FBvHB_splitAge_down[[x]][1:8,])
  colnames(top) <- sub(".*\\.", "", colnames(top))
  
  title <- paste0("Forebrain vs Hindbrain, ", x)
  p0 <- ggplot(all, aes(x=Log2FC, y=-log10(FDR))) + 
    geom_point(aes(color=DAR, size=FDR), shape=19) + 
    xlab("log2(fold change)") + ylab("-log10(FDR)") + 
    ggtitle(title) + theme_minimal() + 
    guides(colour = guide_legend(title="Direction", override.aes = list(shape=19, size=2)), 
           size = guide_legend(title="FDR")) + 
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#53CC67", "grey","#FDE333")) +
    scale_size_continuous(trans = "reverse",breaks = c(1,0.05, 0.01), 
                          limits = c(1,0),range = c(1,2), name = "FDR") + 
    theme(text = element_text(size = 13), plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face="bold", vjust = 2.5),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) + 
    geom_label_repel(size = 3, data = top, min.segment.length = unit(0, 'lines'), 
                     aes(x = Log2FC, y = -log10(FDR), label=name, size=0.1),
                     show.legend=FALSE, max.overlaps = 10, force = 100)
  p2[[x]] <- p0
  rm(x, all, top, p0, title)
}
```

```{r}
# grid!
for (x in c(1:2,4:5)){
  p2[[x]] <- p2[[x]] + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
  rm(x)
}

for (x in c(1:2)){
  p2[[x]] <- p2[[x]] + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
  rm(x)
}
p1 <- p1 + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

png("./ArchR_EHB/Plots/Script3/grid_volcano_FBvHB_5ct.png", width = 2000, height = 1200, res = 160)
p1 + p2 + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
dev.off()

rm(p1, p2, allpeaks)
```


### main fig - venn plot
```{r}
# extract DAG
DAG_up <- list(CS14=FBvHB_splitAge_up$CS14$name, CS16=FBvHB_splitAge_up$CS16$name, 
               CS17=FBvHB_splitAge_up$CS17$name, CS20=FBvHB_splitAge_up$CS20$name, CS21=FBvHB_splitAge_up$CS21$name)
DAG_down <- list(CS14=FBvHB_splitAge_down$CS14$name, CS16=FBvHB_splitAge_down$CS16$name, 
                 CS17=FBvHB_splitAge_down$CS17$name, CS20=FBvHB_splitAge_down$CS20$name, CS21=FBvHB_splitAge_down$CS21$name)

p1 <- ggVennDiagram(DAG_up, label = "count") + 
  scale_fill_gradient(low="#faed98",high = "#f5c20a") + 
  ggtitle("Forebrain > Hindbrain") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))
p2 <- ggVennDiagram(DAG_down, label = "count") + 
  scale_fill_gradient(low="#b2f7be",high = "#02b51f") + 
  ggtitle("Hindbrain > Forebrain") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))

png("./ArchR_EHB/Plots/Script3/grid_Venn_FBvHB_5ct.png", width = 2000, height = 1000, res = 230)
p1 + p2
dev.off()

rm(p1, p2)
```


### main fig - STRING network
```{r}
# get DAGs that are found in all five ages
DAG_up_overlap <- Reduce(intersect, DAG_up)
DAG_down_overlap <- Reduce(intersect, DAG_down)
```

Step 1: prepare gene lists
```{r}
# up-regulated: change C21orf62 to EPCIP
DAG_up_overlap <- sub("C21orf62","EPCIP",DAG_up_overlap)
write.table(DAG_up_overlap, "./data_output/Script3_STRING/DAG_up_genes.txt", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, sep = '\t', quote=FALSE)

# down-regulated:
write.table(DAG_down_overlap, "./data_output/Script3_STRING/DAG_down_genes.txt", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, sep = '\t', quote=FALSE) # remove CCDC140 (long non-coding RNA)
```

Step 2: STRING protein association network
https://string-db.org/

Step 3: ensembl get gene annotation (many are non-coding!)
https://www.ensembl.org/biomart/martview/
```{r}
DAG_up_mart <- read.delim("./data_output/Script3_STRING/DAG_up_mart.txt")
DAG_down_mart <- read.delim("./data_output/Script3_STRING/DAG_down_mart.txt")
```


### main/supp fig - heatmap
```{r}
# plotting: FB > HB
DAG_up_overlap <- sub("EPCIP","C21orf62",DAG_up_overlap)
DAG_up_overlap_df <- list()
for (x in names(FBvHB_splitAge_up)){
  DAG_up_overlap_df[[x]] <- FBvHB_splitAge_up[[x]][FBvHB_splitAge_up[[x]]$name %in% DAG_up_overlap, c("name","Log2FC","FDR")]
  DAG_up_overlap_df[[x]]$age <- x
  rm(x)
}
DAG_up_overlap_df <- do.call(rbind, DAG_up_overlap_df)
heatmap_data <- as.data.frame(pivot_wider(DAG_up_overlap_df[,c(1,2,4)], names_from = name, values_from = Log2FC))
row.names(heatmap_data) <- heatmap_data$age
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[,2:ncol(heatmap_data)]

# add gene types (coding or not?)
df <- DAG_up_mart[!is.na(as.numeric(DAG_up_mart$Chromosome.scaffold.name)),]
df <- data.frame(Gene.type = df[, "Gene.type"], row.names = df[, "Gene.name"])
names(df) <- "type"
df$type <- sub("_coding", "",df$type)


# correct gene name
names(heatmap_data)[names(heatmap_data)=="C21orf62"] <- "EPCIP"

Heatmap(t(heatmap_data), cluster_columns = FALSE, cluster_rows = TRUE, name = "log2(FC)",
        column_title = "Forebrain > Hindbrain", column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 15),
        col = circlize::colorRamp2(seq(min(heatmap_data), max(heatmap_data), length.out = 3), c("#faeec0", "#ffc800", "#ffa200")),
        left_annotation = rowAnnotation(type = df[colnames(heatmap_data),], col = list(type = c("miRNA"="#CCCCFF", "lncRNA"="#6495ED", "protein"="#9FE2BF"))))
```

```{r}
# plotting: HB > FB
DAG_down_overlap_df <- list()
for (x in names(FBvHB_splitAge_down)){
  DAG_down_overlap_df[[x]] <- FBvHB_splitAge_down[[x]][FBvHB_splitAge_down[[x]]$name %in% DAG_down_overlap, c("name","Log2FC","FDR")]
  DAG_down_overlap_df[[x]]$age <- x

}

Heatmap(t(heatmap_data), cluster_columns = FALSE, cluster_rows = TRUE, name = "log2(fold change)",

        col = circlize::colorRamp2(seq(min(heatmap_data), max(heatmap_data), length.out = 3), c("#baf5c4","#53CC67","#008216")),
```

### GO enrichment
```{r}
# functional enrichment ~ 2.5 min
FBvHB_GO <- list(hyper=NULL, hypo=NULL)
FBvHB_GO_full <- list(hyper=NULL, hypo=NULL)
for (x in names(FBvHB_splitCT)){
  print(x)
  GO <- enrichGO(FBvHB_splitCT_up[[x]]$name, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, 
                   keyType = "SYMBOL", pAdjustMethod = "BH", ont = "ALL")
  FBvHB_GO_full[["hyper"]][[x]] <- GO
  FBvHB_GO[["hyper"]][[x]] <- cbind(GO@result, celltype=x, direction="hyper")
  
  GO <- enrichGO(FBvHB_splitCT_down[[x]]$name, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, 
                   keyType = "SYMBOL", pAdjustMethod = "BH", ont = "ALL")
  FBvHB_GO[["hypo"]][[x]] <- cbind(GO@result, celltype=x, direction="hypo")
  FBvHB_GO_full[["hypo"]][[x]] <- GO
  rm(x, GO)
}
FBvHB_GO_merged <- list(hyper=NULL, hypo=NULL)
FBvHB_GO_merged$hyper <- do.call(rbind, FBvHB_GO$hyper)
FBvHB_GO_merged$hypo <- do.call(rbind, FBvHB_GO$hypo)

rm(FBvHB_GO)
```

#### supp fig - FB > HB
```{r}
# take the average p value and gene count for duplicate GO terms (found in multiple cell types)
# this should not affect clustering
top10 <- FBvHB_GO_merged$hyper %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% slice(1:10)
result <- data.frame(top10)
result$Count_avg <- result$Count
result$pvalue_avg <- result$pvalue
for (x in unique(result$ID)){
  result$Count_avg[result$ID==x] <- as.integer(mean(result$Count[result$ID==x]))
  result$pvalue_avg[result$ID==x] <- mean(result$pvalue[result$ID==x])
  rm(x)
}
result <- distinct(result, ID, .keep_all = TRUE) # remove duplicated GO, keeping the first
row.names(result) <- result$ID
result$Count <- result$Count_avg
result$pvalue <- result$pvalue_avg
trial <- FBvHB_GO_full$hyper[[1]]
trial@result <- result
rm(result)

# tree plot
#semData <- godata('org.Hs.eg.db', keytype = "ENTREZID", ont = "BP", computeIC = TRUE) # the same for BP/MF/CC
GO <- pairwise_termsim(trial, method = "Wang", semData = semData)   # using the Wang similarity

# look at the dendrogram and manually set a number for ncluster
p <- treeplot(GO, showCategory=nrow(GO), fontsize=4, cluster.params = list(n = 5), cex_category = 0)
p
```

```{r}
# extract clustering order
trial <- data.frame(p$data)
trial <- trial[!is.na(trial$label),1:10]
top10$Description <- factor(top10$Description, levels=trial$label[order(trial$y)])
top10$celltype <- factor(top10$celltype, levels = c("Radial glia","Neuronal IPC","Neuroblast","Neuron"))

# dot plot
ggplot(top10, aes(x=celltype, y=Description, colour=celltype, size=p.adjust, shape=ONTOLOGY)) + 
  geom_point() + scale_y_discrete() + DOSE::theme_dose() + 
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(Erythrocyte="#f75c63", Fibroblast="#d1a279", Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff",
                               "Neuronal IPC" = "#40a1ff", 'Radial glia'="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0")) + 
  xlab("") + ylab("") + ggtitle("Forebrain > Hindbrain") +
  scale_size(trans = 'reverse', range=c(3,6)) + 
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title="cell type", override.aes = list(size = 4)), 
         size = guide_legend(title="p.adjust", size = 2), 
         shape = guide_legend(title="GO category", size=2, override.aes = list(size = 4))) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5), text=element_text(size=14),
        legend.position = "right")
```

## (2) GO enrichment
```{r}
# get cell type specific genes (DAG-up)
DAG_UP <- getMarkers(ctMarkerGenes_bulk, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6")

# GO enrichment: use top 1000 (or all if < 1000) ~ 1 min
GO_ctSpecific_full <- list()
GO_ctSpecific <- list()
for (x in ctMarkerGenes_bulk@colData@rownames){
  genes <- DAG_UP[[x]]$name[1:min(length(DAG_UP[[x]]$name), 1000)]
  GO_ctSpecific_full[[x]] <- enrichGO(genes, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL", pAdjustMethod = "BH", ont = "ALL")
  GO_ctSpecific[[x]] <- cbind(GO_ctSpecific_full[[x]]@result, celltype=x)
  rm(x, genes)
}
GO_ctSpecific <- do.call(rbind, GO_ctSpecific)

rm(DAG_UP)
```

```{r}
# take the average p value and gene count for duplicate GO terms (found in multiple cell types)
top5 <- GO_ctSpecific %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% slice(1:5)
result <- data.frame(top5)
result$Count_avg <- result$Count
result$pvalue_avg <- result$pvalue
for (x in unique(result$ID)){
  result$Count_avg[result$ID==x] <- as.integer(mean(result$Count[result$ID==x]))
  result$pvalue_avg[result$ID==x] <- mean(result$pvalue[result$ID==x])
  rm(x)
}
result <- distinct(result, ID, .keep_all = TRUE) # remove duplicated GO, keeping the first
row.names(result) <- result$ID
result$Count <- result$Count_avg
result$pvalue <- result$pvalue_avg

# GO clustering
trial <- GO_ctSpecific_full[[1]]
trial@result <- result
rm(result)

# tree plot
semData <- godata('org.Hs.eg.db', keytype = "ENTREZID", ont = "BP", computeIC = TRUE) # the same for BP/MF/CC
GO <- pairwise_termsim(trial, method = "Wang", semData = semData)   # using the Wang similarity
p <- treeplot(GO, showCategory=nrow(GO), fontsize=4, cluster.params = list(n = 7), cex_category = 0) # look at the dendrogram and manually set a number for ncluster
p
```

## (6) [motif] chromVAR

chromVAR output = motif accessibility
  *Deviations*: a bias-corrected measurement of how far the per-cell accessibility of a given motif deviates from the expected accessibility based on the average of all cells and samples.
  *z-score*: also confusingly known as a “deviation score” - is the z-score for each bias-corrected deviation across all cells.

```{r}
# check that motif annotations were added: list contains "Motif"
ArchR_EHB_5ct@peakAnnotation

# add background peaks
ArchR_EHB_5ct <- addBgdPeaks(ArchR_EHB_5ct)

# compute per-cell deviations using chromVAR, add to arrow files ~ 190 min
addArchRThreads(2)
ArchR_EHB_5ct <- addDeviationsMatrix(ArchR_EHB_5ct, peakAnnotation = "Motif", force = TRUE)
save(ArchR_EHB_5ct, file = "./data_rda/Script3/ArchR_EHB_5ct.rda")
```

```{r}
# variability for each motif across all cells
getVarDeviations(ArchR_EHB_5ct, name = "MotifMatrix", plot = TRUE)
getSeqnames(ArchR_EHB_5ct, "MotifMatrix") # "deviations", "z"
```

# 3.ct motif corroboration
## (1) Filters

Filter 1 - motif enrichment
```{r}
# ct-spc-peak-enriched TFs
df1 <- ctMarkerMotifs_bulk@assays@data$mlog10Padj
row.names(df1) <- sub("_.*","",row.names(df1))
df2 <- ctMarkerMotifs_bulk@assays@data$Enrichment
row.names(df2) <- sub("_.*","",row.names(df2))

FilterList_1_motif <- list()
for (x in names(df1)){
  FilterList_1_motif[[x]] <- row.names(df1)[df1[,x] >= -log10(0.01) & df2[,x] >= 1.2 ]
}

rm(x, df1, df2)
```

Filter 2 - motif accessibility (chromVAR)
```{r}

FilterList_2_chromVAR <- list()
for (x in unique(markerMotifs$group_name)){
  FilterList_2_chromVAR[[x]] <- markerMotifs$name[markerMotifs$group_name==x]
  FilterList_2_chromVAR[[x]] <- sub("_.*","",FilterList_2_chromVAR[[x]])
}
rm(x, markerMotifs)
```

```{r}

rm(x, markerGenes)
```

## (2) Filters 1+2
### supp fig - Venn
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script3/Motif_Filterlists.rda")
load("./data_rda/Script3/ctMarkerMotifs_bulk.rda")
load("./data_rda/Script3/ctMarkerMotifs_bulk_chromVAR.rda")
```

```{r}
# hypergeometric test: is the overlap between two filters significant (higher than random overlap)?
hyper_p <- vector()
for (x in 1:length(FilterList_1_motif)){
  overlap <- length(intersect(FilterList_1_motif[[x]], FilterList_2_chromVAR[[x]]))
  setA <- length(FilterList_1_motif[[x]])
  setB <- length(FilterList_2_chromVAR[[x]])
  hyper_p <- c(hyper_p, phyper(q = overlap - 1, m = setA, n = nrow(ctMarkerMotifs_bulk) - setA, k = setB, lower.tail = FALSE))
  rm(x, overlap, setA, setB)
}
names(hyper_p) <- names(FilterList_1_motif)

# Venn plot
p <- list()
for (x in names(FilterList_1_motif)){
  p[[x]] <- ggVennDiagram(list("A" = FilterList_1_motif[[x]], "B" = FilterList_2_chromVAR[[x]]), 
                          edge_lty = "dashed", edge_size = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low=colorspace::lighten(colour[x], amount = 0.7), high=colour[x]) + 
    ggtitle(x) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), legend.position = "none") + 
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1))
  
  caption <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 1, label = paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.1e", hyper_p[x])), size = 4) + theme_void()
  p[[x]] <- p[[x]] / caption + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.08))
  
  rm(x, caption)
}

png("./ArchR_EHB/Plots/Script3/grid_Venn_ct1.png", width = 1800, height = 500, res = 160)
wrap_plots(p, ncol=5)
dev.off()

rm(p, hyper_p)
```

```{r}
# add cell type
point <- list()
for (x in motifs_fil){
  significant <- FilterList_overlap_top10$group_name[FilterList_overlap_top10$name==x]
  point[[x]] <- ggplot() + theme_void()
  for (y in 1:(7-length(significant))){
    point[[x]] <- point[[x]] + annotate("point", x = y, y = 1, size = 1, color = "white")
  }
  for (y in 1:length(significant)){
    point[[x]] <- point[[x]] + annotate("point", x = y+(7-length(significant)), y = 1, size = 1, color = colour[significant[y]])
  }
}

# grid formatting
for (i in 1:length(p)) {
  p[[i]] <- p[[i]] + theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm"))
  if (!i %in% seq(1, length(p), by = 7)){
    p[[i]] <- p[[i]] + ylab("")
  }
  if (!i %in% (length(p)+1-7):length(p)){
    p[[i]] <- p[[i]] + xlab("")
  }
}

# add points
for (x in names(p)){
    p[[x]] <- p[[x]] + point[[x]] + plot_layout(design = c(area(t = 5, l = 1, b = 30, r = 30), area(t = 1, l = 15, b =5, r = 30),
                                                                    area(t = 1, l = 13, b =5, r = 18)))
}
```

## (3) Filters 1+2+3
### supp fig - correlation (no filter)

Do gene score (TF gene accessibility) and chromVAR z score (target motif accessibility) correlate with each other?
If so, in which cell type and which TF motifs?

```{r}
# chromVAR
motifMatrix <- getMatrixFromProject(ArchR_EHB_5ct, useMatrix = "MotifMatrix") # ~ 20s
rownames(motifMatrix) <- sub("_.*","",rownames(motifMatrix))
corInput_chromVAR <- motifMatrix@assays@data$z
rownames(corInput_chromVAR) <- sub("_.*","",rownames(corInput_chromVAR))
rm(motifMatrix)

# gene score
load("./data_rda/Script1/GeneScoreMatrix.rda")
exist <- rownames(corInput_chromVAR)[rownames(corInput_chromVAR) %in% rownames(GeneScoreMatrix)]
corInput_geneScore <- GeneScoreMatrix[exist, colnames(corInput_chromVAR)]
sum(colnames(corInput_chromVAR) == colnames(corInput_geneScore)) == ncol(corInput_geneScore)
rm(GeneScoreMatrix)
```

```{r}
# Spearman's correlation ~ 2 min
# warning "Cannot compute exact p-value with ties" - it is safe to ignore it. Spearman's rank correlation assigns rank, and tied values will cause the p-values to be approximate not exact.
correlation_table <- list()
for (x in unique(ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0)){
  print(x)
  correlation_table[[x]] <- data.frame()
  fil_chromVAR <- corInput_chromVAR[, ArchR_EHB_5ct$cellNames[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==x]]
  fil_geneScore <- corInput_geneScore[, ArchR_EHB_5ct$cellNames[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==x]]
  for (y in rownames(corInput_geneScore)){
    out <- cor.test(fil_chromVAR[y,], as.vector(fil_geneScore[y,]@assays@data$GeneScoreMatrix), method = "spearman")
    out <- data.frame(p_value = out$p.value, coefficient = out$estimate)  # coefficient = Spearman's rho
    correlation_table[[x]] <- rbind(correlation_table[[x]], out)
  }
  rownames(correlation_table[[x]]) <- rownames(corInput_geneScore)
  rm(x, y, out, fil_chromVAR, fil_geneScore)
}

# multiple testing correction
for (x in names(correlation_table)){
  correlation_table[[x]]$p_FDR <- p.adjust(correlation_table[[x]]$p_value, method = "BH")
  correlation_table[[x]]$mlog10FDR <- -log10(correlation_table[[x]]$p_FDR)
  rm(x)
}

save(corInput_chromVAR, corInput_geneScore, correlation_table, file = "./data_rda/Script3/Spearman_correlation.rda")
rm(corInput_chromVAR, corInput_geneScore)
```

```{r}
# significant threshold
correlation_list <- list()
for (x in names(correlation_table)){
  correlation_list[[x]] <- list()
  positive <- na.omit(correlation_table[[x]][correlation_table[[x]]$p_FDR <= 0.01 & correlation_table[[x]]$coefficient >= 0.2,])
  correlation_list[[x]]$positive <- row.names(positive)
  negative <- na.omit(correlation_table[[x]][correlation_table[[x]]$p_FDR <= 0.01 & correlation_table[[x]]$coefficient <= -0.2,])
  correlation_list[[x]]$negative <- row.names(negative)
  rm(x, positive, negative)
}

# get correlatoin output
cor_positive <- list()
cor_negative <- list()
for (x in names(correlation_table)){
  if (length(correlation_list[[x]]$positive != 0)){
    cor_positive[[x]] <- correlation_table[[x]][correlation_list[[x]]$positive,]
    cor_positive[[x]]$effect <- "positive"
    cor_positive[[x]]$gene <- row.names(cor_positive[[x]])
    cor_positive[[x]]$celltype <- x
  }
  
  if (length(correlation_list[[x]]$negative != 0)){
    cor_negative[[x]] <- correlation_table[[x]][correlation_list[[x]]$negative,]
    cor_negative[[x]]$effect <- "negative"
    cor_negative[[x]]$gene <- row.names(cor_negative[[x]])
    cor_negative[[x]]$celltype <- x
  }
  
  rm(x)
}
cor_positive <- do.call(rbind, cor_positive)
cor_negative <- do.call(rbind, cor_negative)
row.names(cor_positive) <- NULL
row.names(cor_negative) <- NULL
```

```{r}
# plot positive
p1 <- ggplot(cor_positive, aes(x=gene, y=celltype)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = coefficient)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = rev(hcl.colors(9, palette = "Inferno")), name = "Spearman's \ncoefficient") +
  theme_light() + ggtitle("Positive correlation") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))

# plot negative
p2 <- ggplot(cor_negative, aes(x=gene, y=celltype)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = coefficient)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = rev(hcl.colors(9, palette = "BuPu")), name = "Spearman's \ncoefficient") +
  theme_light() + ggtitle("Negative correlation") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))

png("./ArchR_EHB/Plots/Script3/correlation_result.png", width = 1600, height = 800, res = 160)

dev.off()
```

### supp fig - 3-layer heatmap
```{r}
# layer 1 - motif enrichment score
motif_enrichScore <- ctMarkerMotifs_bulk@assays@data$Enrichment
rownames(motif_enrichScore) <- sub("_.*","",rownames(motif_enrichScore))
motif_enrichScore <- motif_enrichScore[unique(unlist(FliterList_overlap)),]

# layer 2 - TF gene score
load("./data_rda/Script1/GeneScoreMatrix.rda")
geneScore_fil <- GeneScoreMatrix[unique(unlist(FliterList_overlap)),]
rm(GeneScoreMatrix)
geneScore_summary <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(unique(unlist(FliterList_overlap))), ncol=0))
for (x in names(FliterList_overlap)){
  geneScore_summary <- cbind(geneScore_summary, rowMeans(geneScore_fil[,ArchR_EHB$ctAnnot_2.0==x]@assays@data$GeneScoreMatrix))
}

rownames(geneScore_summary) <- geneScore_fil@NAMES
rm(x, geneScore_fil)

# layer 3 - chromVAR z score
motifMatrix <- getMatrixFromProject(ArchR_EHB_5ct, useMatrix = "MotifMatrix") # ~ 20s
rownames(motifMatrix) <- sub("_.*","",rownames(motifMatrix))
motifMatrix_fil <- motifMatrix[unique(unlist(FliterList_overlap)),]
rm(motifMatrix)
chromVAR_summary <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(unique(unlist(FliterList_overlap))), ncol=0))
for (x in names(FliterList_overlap)){
  df <- motifMatrix_fil[, ArchR_EHB_5ct$cellNames[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==x]]

rm(x, motifMatrix_fil)

# combine three layers
motif_enrichScore$gene <- rownames(motif_enrichScore)
motif_enrichScore <- pivot_longer(motif_enrichScore, cols = 1:(ncol(motif_enrichScore)-1), names_to = "celltype", values_to = "motifEnrichScore")
geneScore_summary$gene <- rownames(geneScore_summary)
geneScore_summary <- pivot_longer(geneScore_summary, cols = 1:(ncol(geneScore_summary)-1), names_to = "celltype", values_to = "geneScore")
chromVAR_summary$gene <- rownames(chromVAR_summary)

heatmap_summary <- merge(heatmap_summary, chromVAR_summary, by = c("gene","celltype"))

save(heatmap_summary, file = "./data_rda/Script3/heatmap_summary.rda")
```

```{r}
df2 <- ctMarkerMotifs_ctRegion@assays@data$Enrichment

FilterList_1_motif_ctRegion <- setNames(rep(list(character(0)), length(unique(ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctRegion))), unique(ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctRegion))
for (x in names(df1)){
  FilterList_1_motif_ctRegion[[x]] <- row.names(df1)[df1[,x] >= -log10(0.01) & df2[,x] >= 1.2 ]
```

```{r}
}
rm(x, markerMotifs)
```

```{r}
  FilterList_3_genescore_ctRegion[[x]] <- markerGenes$name[markerGenes$group_name==x]
}
rm(x, markerGenes)
```

```{r}
                plotAs = "ridges", ridgeScale = 1.5, pal = colour_AgRg) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(group_order)) 
  } else {
    p[[i]] <- plotGroups(ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==i & ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region!="Forebrain",],
                groupBy = "RegionAge", colorBy = "MotifMatrix", name = markerMotifs[grepl(select[i], markerMotifs)], 
                plotAs = "ridges", ridgeScale = 1.5, pal = colour_AgRg_glioblast) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(group_order)) 
  }
  
  if (i %ni% c("Neuron")){
    p[[i]] <- p[[i]] + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
  }
  
  p[[i]] <- p[[i]] + xlab("") + ylab("") + 
    ggtitle(paste0(select[i], ", ", i)) + theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm"))
  
  rm(i)
}

png("./ArchR_EHB/Plots/Script3/grid_chromVAR_ridges_ctRegionAge.png", width = 1500, height = 800, res = 200)
wrap_plots(p[c("Neuron", "Neuroblast", "Neuronal IPC", "Radial glia", "Glioblast")], ncol = length(p))
dev.off()
```

```{r}
rm(p, select, markerMotifs, colour_AgRg, group_order)
```



### main fig - 3-layer heatmap
```{r}
# TFs that have gene score
# layer 1 - motif enrichment score
motif_enrichScore <- ctMarkerMotifs_ctRegion@assays@data$Enrichment
rownames(motif_enrichScore) <- sub("_.*","",rownames(motif_enrichScore))
motif_enrichScore <- motif_enrichScore[unique(unlist(FliterList_overlap_ctRegion)),]

# layer 2 - TF gene score
load("./data_rda/Script1/GeneScoreMatrix.rda")
exist <- rownames(GeneScoreMatrix)[rownames(GeneScoreMatrix) %in% unique(unlist(FliterList_overlap_ctRegion))]
geneScore_fil <- GeneScoreMatrix[exist,]
rm(GeneScoreMatrix)
geneScore_summary <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(exist), ncol=0))
for (x in names(FliterList_overlap_ctRegion)){
  geneScore_summary <- cbind(geneScore_summary, rowMeans(geneScore_fil[,ArchR_EHB$ctRegion==x]@assays@data$GeneScoreMatrix))
}
names(geneScore_summary) <- names(FliterList_overlap_ctRegion)
rownames(geneScore_summary) <- geneScore_fil@NAMES
rm(x, geneScore_fil)
motif_enrichScore <- motif_enrichScore[exist,]

# layer 3 - chromVAR z score
motifMatrix <- getMatrixFromProject(ArchR_EHB_5ct, useMatrix = "MotifMatrix") # ~ 20s
rownames(motifMatrix) <- sub("_.*","",rownames(motifMatrix))
motifMatrix_fil <- motifMatrix[exist,]
rm(motifMatrix)
chromVAR_summary <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(exist), ncol=0))
for (x in names(FliterList_overlap_ctRegion)){
  df <- motifMatrix_fil[, ArchR_EHB_5ct$cellNames[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctRegion==x]]
  chromVAR_summary <- cbind(chromVAR_summary, rowMeans(df@assays@data$z))
}
names(chromVAR_summary) <- names(FliterList_overlap_ctRegion)
rownames(chromVAR_summary) <- sub("_.*","",rownames(chromVAR_summary))
rm(x, motifMatrix_fil)

# combine three layers
motif_enrichScore$gene <- rownames(motif_enrichScore)
motif_enrichScore <- pivot_longer(motif_enrichScore, cols = 1:(ncol(motif_enrichScore)-1), names_to = "celltype", values_to = "motifEnrichScore")
geneScore_summary$gene <- rownames(geneScore_summary)
geneScore_summary <- pivot_longer(geneScore_summary, cols = 1:(ncol(geneScore_summary)-1), names_to = "celltype", values_to = "geneScore")
chromVAR_summary$gene <- rownames(chromVAR_summary)
chromVAR_summary <- pivot_longer(chromVAR_summary, cols = 1:(ncol(chromVAR_summary)-1), names_to = "celltype", values_to = "chromVARzScore")
heatmap_summary_ctRegion <- merge(motif_enrichScore, geneScore_summary, by = c("gene","celltype"))
heatmap_summary_ctRegion <- merge(heatmap_summary_ctRegion, chromVAR_summary, by = c("gene","celltype"))
heatmap_summary_ctRegion <- na.omit(heatmap_summary_ctRegion)

save(heatmap_summary_ctRegion, file = "./data_rda/Script3/heatmap_summary_ctRegion.rda")
write_xlsx(heatmap_summary_ctRegion, path = "./data_output/Script3_ctMarker/3layer_heatmap_summary_ctRegion.xlsx")
```

```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script3/heatmap_summary_ctRegion.rda")
length(unique(heatmap_summary_ctRegion$gene)) # 69 unique genes

# cluster genes by chromVAR z score
df <- pivot_wider(heatmap_summary_ctRegion[,c("gene","celltype","chromVARzScore")], names_from = gene, values_from = chromVARzScore)
df <- as.data.frame(df)
row.names(df) <- df$celltype
df <- df[,-1]
col_dist <- dist(t(df))
col_clust <- hclust(col_dist)
heatmap_summary_ctRegion$gene <- factor(heatmap_summary_ctRegion$gene, levels = col_clust$labels[col_clust$order])

# cluster cell types by chromVAR z score
row_dist <- dist(df)
row_clust <- hclust(row_dist)
heatmap_summary_ctRegion$celltype <- factor(heatmap_summary_ctRegion$celltype, levels = row_clust$labels[row_clust$order])

# dendrogram for ct
dendro <- dendro_data(as.dendrogram(row_clust), type = "rectangle")
dendro <- ggplot(dendro$segments) + geom_segment(aes(x = y, xend = yend, y = x, yend = xend)) + theme_void()

# heatmap
p <- ggplot(heatmap_summary_ctRegion, aes(x = gene, y = celltype)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = chromVARzScore)) + theme_bw() + 
  geom_point(aes(colour = motifEnrichScore, size = geneScore), alpha = 0.8, shape = 16) +
  geom_point(aes(size = geneScore), shape = 1) + # add borders
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = rev(hcl.colors(9, palette = "ag_Sunset")), values = scales::rescale(c(0, 1, 4)),
                       name = "chromVAR z score \naccessibility (heatmap)") +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = rev(hcl.colors(9, palette = "ag_Sunset")), values = scales::rescale(c(-4, 0, 12)),
                         name = "motif enrichment \nscore (dot plot)") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 8), name = "gene score") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 11), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12), 
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal",
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank())

p + dendro + plot_layout(widths = c(15, 1))
```

```{r}
# Manually adding a top dendrogram (gene clustering)
dendro_gene <- dendro_data(as.dendrogram(col_clust), type = "rectangle")
dendro_gene$segments$y <- log(dendro_gene$segments$y + 1)
dendro_gene$segments$yend <- log(dendro_gene$segments$yend + 1)
ggplot(dendro_gene$segments) + geom_segment(aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend)) + theme_void()
```

```{r}
rm(df, col_dist, col_clust, row_dist, row_clust)
rm(p, dendro, heatmap_summary_ctRegion, geneScore_summary, motif_enrichScore, chromVAR_summary)
```
